content:
In addition to macOS 26.6, Apple has simultaneously released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, which include important bug fixes. Here are the details.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 have finally been officially released

After testing through as many as seven Release Candidate versions, Apple has finally officially released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8.

The official version numbers are the same as last week's Release Candidates:

  • macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 (23J620)
  • macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 (24G824)

Apple's release notes only mention that these two updates provide "important security fixes" and recommend that all users still on macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia install them as soon as possible.

In recent weeks, Apple has pushed out multiple security fixes for older system versions, many of which patch WebKit vulnerabilities to prevent user data from being at risk. Therefore, if you're still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia, it's recommended that you install these updates as soon as possible.

Update: Apple has published the full security content for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, detailing a combined total of more than 138 different vulnerabilities across the two systems.

Are you still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
